## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle (1卷) Cuṇḍā (Zhǔntí 准提) repentance liturgy preserved as **X74 no. 1482** of the *Xùzàngjīng*. The catalog assigns the work to the early-Míng visionary lay practitioner [夏道人](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%8F%E9%81%93%E4%BA%BA) Xià Dàorén under the function 集 (compiled). The DILA Buddhist-persons authority file (A000904) likewise places Xià in the Míng (correcting the Xùzàngjīng catalog's 清 attribution, which reflects the dynasty of the *received printed recension*, not of Xià's life). The work as transmitted in the *Xùzàngjīng* is in fact the Qing-Shùnzhì-period printed recension prepared by the Xiàng 項 family of Jiāhé 嘉禾 (modern Jiāxīng 嘉興) — published in 順治壬辰 = 1652 (re-printing preface by [項謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%A0%85%E8%AC%99) Xiàng Qiān) and reissued with two further prefaces in 順治丁酉 = 1657 (preface by [譚貞默](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%AD%9A%E8%B2%9E%E9%BB%98) Tán Zhēnmò *Sǎo'ān* 埽菴, *jìnshì* of 戊辰 1628; further preface by [道盛](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E7%9B%9B) Juélàng Dàoshèng 覺浪道盛, the late-Míng Cáodòng Chán master, sobriquet *Làngzhàngrén* 浪杖人).

**Abstract**

The *Zhǔntí fénxiū xīdì chànhuǐ xuánwén* is one of the principal late-Míng / early-Qīng *Cuṇḍā* repentance liturgies, transmitted within the broader *Cuṇḍā* devotional movement that took shape from the late-Wànlì period (cf. *Zhǔntí jìngyè* 准提淨業 ([KR6j0750](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0750)) by [謝于教](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%AC%9D%E4%BA%8E%E6%95%99) Xiè Yújiào, 1618–1623; [KR6j0751](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0751); and the related Tiāntái-school *Zhǔntí sānmèi xíngfǎ* ([KR6j0759](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0759)) by [受登](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%97%E7%99%BB) Shòudēng, 1665). The text's *origin-story* — a Míng-dynasty Fújiàn weaver receiving the liturgy and protector-images in dreams from an "old monk", with the protector-figures emerging from a mirror — places it firmly in the **vision-and-image** mode of late-Míng popular Esoteric Buddhism, in dialogue with the protector-deity image traditions of late-Míng Buddhist visual culture. The *Cuṇḍā* mantra itself is the late-Tang Tantric *Cundī* dhāraṇī (the *Sapta-koṭi-buddha-mātṛ* incantation), but the present work organizes a one-fascicle ritual *chàn* 懺 (repentance liturgy) around it: opening purifications (淨口/淨身/淨手 *zhēnyán*), the *rùtán sānlǐ* 入壇三禮 (three altar-prostrations), the *zhìxīn chànhuǐ* 志心懺悔 confession, the *Dàlún míngwáng mièzuì zhēnyán* 大輪明王滅罪真言, and *zhìxīn fāyuàn* 志心發願. The transmission line as documented here runs Xià Dàorén (Míng) → Yǐnkōng of Guǎngjìsì (Fújiàn) → the Xiàng family (Jiāhé) → 1652/1657 prints. The *Xùzàngjīng* recension carries the three prefaces and the liturgical text; the protector-deity images mentioned in the prefaces are not reproduced in the modern edition.

**Catalog-vs-external dating note.** The Xùzàngjīng catalog and the project meta both label the work *Qīng* 清, which corresponds to the publication date of the received recension (1652–1657). DILA A000904 places Xià Dàorén in the *Míng*, which is correct for his life-dates. The composition window adopted here (notBefore = 1652, notAfter = 1657) reflects the received printed recension, in line with the project rule for layered/recompiled works.
